# The Hollow — original skeletal-warrior tile

Artwork: **roctavian**, “Improved undead tiles”, 17 September 2016.

Pinned upstream revision: `7c9bbd012c6538499643b2da006c16a7c6fee1e0` in https://github.com/crawl/crawl . Original path: `crawl-ref/source/rltiles/mon/undead/skeletal_warrior.png`.

The upstream tile-directory licence identifies the RLTiles artwork as public domain. The current project licence lists tile artwork as Public Domain / CC0 separately from the GPL program code. Both licence notices are retained here. Only the unchanged tile image is used, not program code. The 2016 artist revision predates generative-image tools; this is existing authored pixel art, not a newly generated sprite.

The original 32×32 image is rendered with nearest-neighbour integer enlargement. No palette changes, tracing or synthesized animation frames are used. Hollow phase / attack / death effects remain separate game rendering, not sprite edits. Stats and its two-by-two footprint are unchanged.
